title: Assignment
description:
subject x facet -> path, with evidence, in one file. An assignment without provenance is an opinion, so evidence and provenance are required and confidence has no default.

This document is FLAT. Evidence and provenance were nested objects in v0.0.1 and evidence was a list of them, which made the store unreadable by its own reader and unreadable by any thirty-line reader in another language. They are now scalars.

One consequence is deliberate: a subject with two independent pieces of evidence for the same path is TWO assignments, not one assignment with two evidence items. That is a better shape anyway - each piece of evidence can then carry its own confidence, which a shared list could not express.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. REQUIRED, and never defaulted to 1. A value of 1 asserts the fact was read directly off the artefact, not inferred from it. If you are tempted to write 1 because you have nothing better, the honest value is lower and evidence_kind should say why.

evidence_kind.description: What sort of observation this is. Deliberately not an enum: the set grows as sources do, and closing it here would mean a schema change to record a new kind of evidence.

provenance_by.description: agent, human, or the name of a tool.

provenance_prompt.description: Ledger entry this assignment came from, so any row can be traced back to the implementation that wrote it.
